Title: 1 in 4 US Adults Has Fatty Liver? 3 Diet Triggers to Know

Description:
Tired no matter how much you rest, with a dull ache under your right ribs? About 1 in 4 US adults has fatty liver disease, and NIDDK calls it a 'silent epidemic' — it often shows no symptoms until it's more advanced.

Three everyday foods are linked to higher liver fat in real studies: fast food, sugary soda (even diet), and red meat. Each one has a simple swap that takes real pressure off your liver.

Watch for the research and the swaps.
